sources.beginner: Hand-calc: Barlow and equivalent length are closed forms (beginner/m02/l03:3, m03/l02); the two solo wellheads are one-variable roots of equations the prompt states (goal seek). Panels are select-only teaching cases.
sources.intermediate: Unobtainable: an 8-unknown looped turbulent solve with allocation/capacity; no NextGen panel takes a custom network (NetworkExplorer.jsx:419 SelectField only) and the Suite Production Network Studio uses a different well/pipe model.
sources.advanced: Linearised twin is hand-calc (Laplacian closed form, intermediate/m01/l01); the other five need the turbulent solve and conservation check, which no learner-facing surface runs (FightExplorer.jsx:301 SelectField only).

fields.evidence: Barlow P = 2 S t f / D on the outside diameter (l03:3): 2 x 60000 x 0.365 x 0.6 / 10.75 = 2444.6512; closed form from prompt inputs, full precision.
L = sum(K) x D / f with the bore in feet (m03/l02-l03): 5.85 x (10.02/12) / 0.0143 = 341.5909; closed form.
Solve 7300(1-0.2x-0.8x^2) = k_s sqrt(p-235) with 1/k_s^2 = 1/430^2 + 1/815^2 (equivalently the prompt's two statements); 561.6258 psia.
fields.notes: One-variable root: the prompt states both equations (Vogel and the flowline+trunk in series) and beginner/m05/l04 explains the single monotone crossing, so a spreadsheet goal seek gets full precision; the lessons show Newton, not a hand iteration, so this rests on the prompt spelling the equations out. NextGen TrunkExplorer is select-only (TrunkExplorer.jsx:179) and does not reach OBIAFU.

fields.recommendation: Give NetworkExplorer/FightExplorer an editable network (wells as Vogel qmax/pr, branches as k, allocation and capacity) or a capstone-shaped builder that runs solveNetwork/checkConservation and prints at least 4 decimals (9 for the gap fraction); otherwise the field is ungradable except by a learner writing their own solver.
fields.evidence: No learner-facing surface runs this network: the NextGen panels are select-only over teaching cases (SelectField only, src/components/course/panels/network/NetworkExplorer.jsx:419, FightExplorer.jsx:301) and networkLab.js carries no capstone material by design (src/components/course/panels/network/panelCapstoneGuard.test.js:1-8); the Suite Production Network Studio (src/utils/production/network.js:406 runNetwork) models wells by nodal curves and pipes by geometry, with no Vogel-in-lb/d or k-root-psi branch input. The lessons teach the engine's Newton solve (intermediate/m01/l02-l03) and never a hand or spreadsheet route for an 8-unknown system with an allocation min() and a capacity limit. Nine-branch looped turbulent solve with OBIAFU-19 allocation and capacity limit.
